name: 84701 · Richfield, UT
findings: ZIP 84701 (Richfield) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84701 (Richfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
